title: Dimension-free bounds for maximal operators associated to log kernel and applications
summary: Let $M_ψ$ be the maximal operator associated to $ψ(x)=-\ln(1-|x|^2)$. We obtain dimension-free bounds on $L^p(\mathbb R^d)$ for $M_ψ$, $1<p\le\infty$. We show that the weak $L^1$ estimate does not hold for $M_ψ$, but does hold for the corresponding lacunary maximal operator $M_ψ^D$. An weak $L\log L$ type estimate for $M_ψ$ is obtained, which seems to be the right substitution for the weak $L^1$ estimate. Estimates for $M_ψ$ are applied to dimension-free estimates for maximal Riesz transforms obtained by Mateu, Verdera, Orobitg and Pérez.
